parsed.rationale_overall: System A demonstrates stronger personalization by tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (income, expenses, net worth gap, tax bracket) and includes a high-impact tax-optimization recommendation directly relevant to closing the $1.045M retirement gap. System B offers more sector-specific actionability aligned with the query but includes several unverifiable historical statistics and a questionable suggestion to increase already-concentrated Healthcare exposure, weakening its factual grounding and diversification awareness.
